name: dsh-fetch-url-firecrawl
description: Local DSH profile plugin: Firecrawl-backed fetch provider for the web capability seam (ctx.web). Calls the Firecrawl scrape API (POST /v2/scrape, markdown format) and normalizes the result to WebFetchResult. Host half registers provider id 'firecrawl' and the 'dsh-fetch-url-firecrawl' settings namespace; browser half registers a card into settings.plugin.item.
